entry.subtitle: P04 · Nat. Commun. 14, 3849 (published 2023-06-29; corrected 2023-08-21). Read after correction.
entry.summary: Honest success p_h >= 1 - exp(-(delta_h^2/3) M(e_h,l_h) N) (20), subject to M(e_h,l_h)(1+delta_h) < (1/2)(1-p_m/2) (21).

fields.label: Anchor
fields.text: Supplementary Note 3C, eqs.(19)-(23), SI PDF p.7-8; Supplementary Table 2 (SI p.10-11); main text Fig.4b

fields.label: Statement summary
fields.text: Honest success p_h >= 1 - exp(-(delta_h^2/3) M(e_h,l_h) N) (20), subject to M(e_h,l_h)(1+delta_h) < (1/2)(1-p_m/2) (21). Dishonest success p_d = P[M(e_d,l_d) <= (1-delta_d)(1/2)(1-p_m/2)] <= exp(-(delta_d^2/2)(1/2)(1-p_m/2) N) (22), with (1/2)(1-p_m/2)(1-delta_d) >= M(e_h,l_h)(1+delta_h) (23). N = number of quantum states used to verify ONE bit of the cryptogram. Total token length lambda = N log2|m| = N log2 sqrt|C|.

values:
  delta_h: 0.031

  N_fig4: 4.2e6

  p_m_SI: 0.0602
  p_m_main: 0.0676

fields.label: Recomputation
fields.text: RECOMPUTED_BY_LANE_A: exp(-(0.01^2/2)*0.5*(1-0.0602/2)*N) gives 5.91e-45 only with N = 4.2e6 (exponent 101.84). With the SI Table 2 N = 4,482,440 it gives 6.3e-48. So the reported p_d uses N = 4.2e6 and p_m = 6.02%.

fields.label: Caveats
items: Chernoff-Hoeffding (SI eqs 7-8) is for sums of independent {0,1} variables. M = (4+2 sqrt2) e + l is a weighted combination with weight > 1. Lane D must check whether the bound is applied within its hypotheses (open question, NOT a claim of error).
Independence across the N states is assumed in the Chernoff step.
MAC forgery p_t = 1/sqrt|C| (main text; SI Note 4) is a separate term. The overall cheating probability composition is not stated as a single theorem.
